notes: H2 header labels from the ESP32-H2 PIN callout table (left column = left physical column, matching the board silkscreen IO13, IO1, IO0, IO3, IO2, IO25, GND, 3V3); right-column silkscreen is mostly hidden. QWIIC labels from the callouts RXD (IO44), TXD (IO43), SCL (IO16), SDA (IO17); board silkscreen beside the connectors reads RXD/TXD/3V3/GND and SCL/SDA/3V3/GND. RS485 terminal labels from the D_GND/A/B/S_GND callout. The 7~24V DC terminal has no per-terminal labels and is skipped; the small 2-pad SGND footprint near the top is skipped. Display RGB, XL9535 and TF card GPIO tables are not wiring points.
uncertain: Board silkscreen near the QWIIC connectors reads SCL---1? (last digit blurred, possibly 18) and SDA---17, while the callout says SCL (IO16); the callout value was used.
RS485 terminal: the callout labels are printed beside the terminal (D_GND top to S_GND bottom) and the board silkscreen near it is mostly hidden; one label per terminal in order assumed.
